contract.prepare: No model requests; fetches current pinned MCP metadata; freezes tasks, catalogs, config, source code and relevant locks. Save plan.json + plan.sha256.
contract.run: v1.3: shared agent; original rubric plus deterministic call counts; five first-valid judge slots, max two logical attempts/slot with one HTTP transport retry each. Immutable request/response/outcome files; no score-driven retries.
contract.resume: Verify frozen files. v1.3 completed execution checkpoint can resume missing judge slots without MCP/agent calls; preserve previous aggregate revisions. Persist attempt counts, never reset budgets. Terminal/ambiguous agent and tool execution is not blindly replayed.
contract.report: Development diagnostic tables; reviewed suites additionally export evaluation manifests/ledgers and matched TF/PE/ECS/recovery/retention/cost CSVs through existing evaluation.py. Truncation and provider filtering are execution failures, not completion.
contract.request_retry: Agent/judge/updater: one identical-request retry for connection failure/429/5xx, backoff 2s and Retry-After up to 60s. Record each retry with unknown usage. No trajectory/tool/semantic retries.
contract.papers: Show CLI identity, user confirms/switches account and selects dedicated site before freeze. New plans use v1.3 config. Draft deployment keyed by site+HTML within run workspace; existing deployment is only verified, unknown submission not repeated.
contract.preflight: Real low-token endpoint requests before new cells, separate costs in preflight/*.json; same plan controls across strategies. Stop after two consecutive model transport failures; untouched cells remain pending.
contract.judge: Original rubric retained verbatim; append concise-counts-v1 input statistics/output instruction. First development probe exposed miscounting; revised four-prompt denominator checks and one live task139 cell passed. Subjective judge/rubric ambiguity remains. Do not mix prior scores.
